ModMetaData.author: Jeremie
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]Atmosphere Overhaul Patch[/h1] 大气层重构 · 第三方温控 Mod 兼容补丁
支持 宜人气候 Good Climate 的主动出风口 支持 原版温度扩展 Vanilla Temperature Expanded 的空调 支持 原版温度扩展 Vanilla Temperature Expanded 的 HeatProxy 机制 支持 中央空调 Centralized Climate Control 的中央空调
特别支持 Frostpunk Heat Generator Tower 《冰汽时代》能量塔 Mod （其基于 HeatProxy 机制工作），现在可以正常玩风雪遗孤了
Support the Good Climate mod's active vents. Support the Vanilla Temperature Expanded mod's central air conditioning system. Support the Vanilla Temperature Expanded mod's HeatProxy mechanism. Support the Centralized Climate Control mod's central air conditioning system.
Special support for the Frostpunk Heat Generator Tower mod, which is based on the HeatProxy mechanism. Now you can play Snowstorm Orphan without issues.
[h2] Support Mod [/h2] [list] [*] [b]宜人气候 Good Climate[/b]（GOS.GoodClimate） https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3669891833
[*] [b]Vanilla Temperature Expanded[/b]（VanillaExpanded.Temperature） https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3202046258
[*] [b]Centralized Climate Control (Continued)[/b]（Mlie.CentralizedClimateControl） https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2007268173
[*] [b]Frostpunk Heat Generator Tower[/b]（HarryRobinson.FrostpunkHeatGeneratorTower） https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3545379519
[*] [b]超维科技 OuterrealmTech[/b]（Jeremie.Fully.Automatic.OmniCrafter） https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3712146789
[*] [b]Replace Stuff[/b]（Memegoddess.ReplaceStuff） https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3526354009 [/list]
使用三种方案替换 Vanilla Temperature Expanded 的 HeatProxy 机制，使其更符合AO的真实世界： 热辐射加热地面、热辐射加热空气、高温热流喷射。 在 Frostpunk Heat Generator Tower 中实现了这个特性。
将 Centralized Climate Control 中的中央空调按照真实世界的中央风管机空调系统原理，采用AO的系统重新进行了实现，实现了从 户外吸入空气、加热/冷却空气、将空气排入室内 的过程。
将 Vanilla Temperature Expanded 的中央空调按照真实世界的多联机冷媒空调系统原理，采用AO的系统重新进行了实现，实现了三热管制VRF架构，室内机制冷的制冷或制热量相互抵消，未抵消的量才需要对应容量的室外机进行补偿。
实现 宜人气候 Good Climate 的主动通风口
支持 超维科技 OuterrealmTech 的 护盾、穹顶、生物圈 ，可以强制稳定环境。想偷懒的时候就可以直接弄来用了。
修复 Replace Stuff 的跨墙通风口 (wall mounted vents) 的一些小问题。
修复 超维科技 OuterrealmTech 万能幻影墙的漏气问题。
玩 风雪遗孤 Snowstorm Orphan 的玩家现在可以利用 HeatProxy 机制保护你的鼠鼠。
如果你厌倦了管理基地某些区域的温度，你可以使用 超维科技 OuterrealmTech 的 生物圈OmniBiosphere / 穹顶OmniForceFieldDome 来强制稳定一个区域的气候状态，也可以使用 能量防御场发生器OmniRectangleEnergyDefenseField 来仅仅保护某个区域的房顶和建筑不被吹飞。
以上所有Mod都为选装，可以根据喜好安装其中任何mod。
[hr][/hr]
[Translate by Google Translate]
Replaces the `HeatProxy` mechanism from *Vanilla Temperature Expanded* with three new methods that better reflect real-world physics: radiant heating of the ground, radiant heating of the air, and high-temperature thermal jet streams. This feature has been implemented in the *Frostpunk Heat Generator Tower*.
Reimplements the central air conditioning system from *Centralized Climate Control* using the mod's own internal systems, modeled after real-world ducted HVAC setups—drawing in outdoor air, conditioning (heating/cooling) it, and distributing it into interior spaces.
Reimplements the central air conditioning system from *Vanilla Temperature Expanded* based on real-world VRF (Variable Refrigerant Flow) technology. It utilizes a three-pipe architecture where cooling and heating demands from indoor units offset one another; only the net remaining load requires compensation from the outdoor unit.
Adds support for active ventilation vents from the *Good Climate* mod.
Adds compatibility with *OuterrealmTech* shields, domes, and biospheres, allowing for forced environmental stabilization—a perfect solution when you want to take a shortcut.
Fixes minor issues with the wall-mounted vents from *Replace Stuff*.
Fixes air leakage issues with the "Universal Phantom Wall" from *OuterrealmTech*.
Players using *Snowstorm Orphan* can now leverage the `HeatProxy` mechanism to keep your Ratkin safe.
If you grow tired of managing temperatures in specific parts of your base, you can use the *OuterrealmTech* "OmniBiosphere" or "OmniForceFieldDome" to force a stable climate within an area. Alternatively, you can use the "OmniRectangleEnergyDefenseField" to protect roofs and structures in a specific zone from being blown away.
All of the above mods are optional and can be installed based on your preferences.
